en.sayed-ali-raza: Beware lest bearers of greed should carry you
and make you descend down to the springs of destruction.
If you can manage that there be no wealthy person between yourself and Allāh, do so,
because in any case you will find what is for you and get your share.
A little received directly from Allāh the Glorified, is more dignified than that which is more but is received through (the obligation of) His creatures, although (really) all is from Allāh.
